title: Mission: The Conveyor Belt
subtitle: Build the conveyor belt and move things from here to there.
summary: Meet the conveyor belt, learn its parts, and send a box down the line.
activityInstruction: Start the motor and carry the box all the way to the end of the belt.

storyQuestions.success: There are books on one table.

storyQuestions.prompt: What is on the other table?
storyQuestions.success: There are toys on the other table.

answers: On the other side of the classroom
storyQuestions.success: The shelves are on the other side of the classroom.

storyQuestions.prompt: Do they have to walk back many times?
storyQuestions.success: Yes, they have to walk back many times.

storyQuestions.prompt: Are there still many things left?
storyQuestions.success: Yes, there are still many things left.

storyQuestions.prompt: Is cleaning up fast or slow?

quiz.prompt: What starts and stops the belt?
quiz.success: The button turns the motor on and off.
A button and switch control the belt.

parts.label: Belt
parts.fact: The belt is the moving surface that carries things across.
parts.help: The wide band across the middle.

parts.label: Roller
parts.fact: The rollers turn underneath the belt to keep it moving.
parts.help: The wheels at each end of the belt.

parts.label: Motor
parts.fact: The motor powers the rollers to drive the belt.
parts.help: The box attached to the side.

parts.label: Button
parts.fact: The switch turns the motor on and off to start and stop the belt.
parts.help: The small button near the motor.

parts.label: Box
parts.fact: The box is the item the conveyor belt carries from one place to another.
parts.help: The brown package sitting on top of the belt.
